We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups. IR spectrum shows peaks; carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1 (typically 1650-1750). The given IR peaks: list includes 1606, 1587, but no ~1700. No carbonyl stretch observed. Could be none. However maybe carbonyl could be conjugated and appear lower ~1680-1700, not present. So answer likely 0.

We could also check carbon NMR for carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Could use carbon_nmr_spectra to confirm, but IR already suggests none. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR quickly.
